connector.name: three.ws Signals
connector.registryDescription: Discover signal feeds ranked by proven edge, rank publishers, and subscribe + track results.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package signals-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the signal-marketplace endpoints. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the live marketplace reads and subscription writes.

env.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
env.description: three.ws API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) for the account-scoped follower tools (get_subscriptions, subscribe_signal, set_subscription_status). Optional — the public discovery and leaderboard tools work without it. subscribe_signal in live mode spends real USDC, so treat this key like cash.
